name: Paris and 1000 km survivor model

spatial_unit.assignment_rule: No cell receives an estimated population until a reproducible spatial allocation method and source are recorded.

calculation.formula: sum over cells and preparedness levels: population_2034 * prepared_share[level] * reachable_refuge_capacity_factor * access_in_time_probability * operational_function_probability

baseline_source.name: Eurostat Census Grid 2021
baseline_source.reason: Common 1 km grid across borders; avoids country-boundary discontinuities.

france_validation_source.name: Insee Census population grid 2021
france_validation_source.reason: National source for cross-checking French cells and age structure.

population_assignment.projection_method: For each 25 km cell, preserve the 2021 fine-grid spatial share, then apply a regional 2034 uplift calibrated to Insee Omphale 2022 regional projections. Do not extrapolate beyond the sourced regional totals.
population_assignment.aggregation_method: Select 1 km cells by centroid within the 1,000 km circle, aggregate to the existing 25 km cells in EPSG:3035, and record edge-cell treatment.
population_assignment.edge_rule: Use exact intersection area for cells crossing the 1,000 km boundary; retain source totals and record clipped_area_fraction.
uncertainty: 2021 census reference date differs from 2034 projection
Eurostat grid download is large and must be processed transiently
fine-grid confidentiality and estimation flags must be retained
regional uplift assumes spatial distribution remains stable between baseline and 2034
not_done: download and process the Eurostat grid

notes: A 25 km regular grid is now the calculation unit. Sourced French regional projections remain in population_reference_regions and are not silently allocated to cells. Cells, refuge capacities and preparedness shares remain draft/unknown until source-backed allocation is implemented.
